name: TECNICAS REUNIDAS EO -,10
summary: TECNICAS REUNIDAS EO -,10 is an international general contractor engaged in engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning of industrial plants, mainly in the oil and gas sector. The company provides services for a wide range of projects, including refining, petrochemicals, gas processing, and power generation, and has its headquarters in Madrid, Spain. The company operates through various subsidiaries and branches worldwide.
